items.title: Premarket movers: Nvidia, Red Cat fall; Home Depot, SpaceX gains
items.summary: Investing.com - U.S. stock index futures fell on Tuesday as investors braced for Nvidia’s quarterly results, looking for fresh evidence that demand for artificial intelligence infrastructure can justify the sector’s lofty expectations. Concerns about slowing data center spending and higher borrowing costs have fueled a broader market selloff in recent weeks, while the sudden departure of Nvidia Chief Executive Jensen Huang has added another layer of uncertainty ahead of the chipmaker’s earnings
